principle: States describe adaptive functions and needs, not human worth, spiritual rank or measured frequency.

states.name: Repliegue
states.function: Reduce demand, protect resources and create basic stability.

states.name: Guardia
states.function: Establish safety, protection, limits and environmental awareness.

states.name: Búsqueda
states.function: Identify needs, desire, curiosity and direction.

states.name: Movilización
states.function: Convert tension, anger or urgency into bounded action.

states.name: Afirmación
states.function: Clarify identity, dignity, position and authorship.
states.visual: stable central form with explicit edges

states.name: Coraje
states.function: Cross a chosen threshold while preserving agency.

states.name: Equilibrio
states.function: Regulate intensity and widen available options.

states.name: Disponibilidad
states.function: Open to learning, participation and reciprocal exchange.

states.name: Integración
states.function: Hold contradiction, memory and multiple perspectives without premature collapse.

states.name: Discernimiento
states.function: Evaluate evidence, uncertainty, alternatives and consequences.

states.name: Vínculo
states.function: Strengthen care, reciprocity, belonging and shared responsibility.

states.name: Vitalidad
states.function: Enable play, creative movement, joy and generative possibility.

states.name: Quietud
states.function: Support peace, silence, broad perception and integration without demand.
states.visual: slow open field and high spatial silence

states.name: Radiancia
states.function: Connect awe, meaning, creativity and contribution without claiming spiritual superiority.
states.visual: white field with pure spectral relations

rules: No state is superior in human value.
A state is contextual and may be adaptive.
No numeric consciousness score is generated.
Self-report and behavior are never treated as diagnosis.
Transitions are invitations, not forced ascents.
The user may stop, reverse or return at any time.
